title: Japanese Writing Task: Letter
description: Write in Japanese focusing on letter. Follow the rubric for assessment.

prompts.prompt: 日本で１週間ホームステイしました。お世話になったホストファミリーに手紙を書きなさい。楽しかった思い出を２つ以上書いて、感謝の気持ちと、また会いたい気持ちを伝えてください。

criteria.name: Task Achievement
criteria.description: Focus: correct format, appropriate audience, required content, suitable length

levels.excellent: 22-25: Fully meets requirements with clear communication purpose
levels.good: 17-21: Meets most requirements with minor issues

criteria.name: Content & Organization
criteria.description: Focus: argument, structure 導入-本論-結論, coherence, connectors

levels.excellent: 22-25: Clear structure with logical flow and appropriate connectors
levels.good: 17-21: Generally logical with some organizational issues

criteria.name: Vocabulary & Expression
criteria.description: Focus: N3-N2 vocabulary, appropriate expressions, natural Japanese

levels.excellent: 22-25: Rich vocabulary with natural, context-appropriate expressions
levels.good: 17-21: Good vocabulary with mostly natural expressions
levels.needsImprovement: 0-11: Very limited vocabulary, many inappropriate expressions

criteria.name: Grammar & Accuracy
criteria.description: Focus: N4-N3-N2 grammar patterns, word order, particles, writing accuracy
